description: Git-style input containing two right-side sections, which Git syntax cannot represent.

normalization.de_indentation: Rust indoc!/snapshot indentation was removed from fixture bytes.
normalization.rust_literal_escape_decoding: Rust byte/string literal escapes were decoded once; fixture files contain resulting bytes.
normalization.eof_display_marker_removal: The upstream [EOF] display marker is metadata only and is not stored in input bytes.
normalization.label_substitutions: No volatile revision, operation, or commit labels were copied; stable library labels are retained.

reason: Git/diff3 style permits only two sides, but this hunk repeats its right-side separator.
